signal = sign(CPI 5d MA - 20d MA) = inflation accelerating. Gold is held as an inflation hedge. NOTE: Erb & Harvey (2013) show this link is weak at horizons under a decade - the weakest of the nine.

direction = sign(GPR 5d MA trend) = geopolitical risk escalating. Same claim as pmf_051113 with a different intensity term.
direction = sign(gold ATM IV 20d MA trend) = implied vol rising = the market is pricing more fear. Gold is a crisis hedge.
